# problem with oh-my-zsh

Fix the first shell after a fresh installation:

```
Last login: Tue Nov 23 10:29:59 on ttys002
/Users/.../.dotfiles/.zshrc:.:65: no such file or directory: /Users/.../.oh-my-zsh/oh-my-zsh.sh
```

The installer appended `source ~/.dotfiles/.zshrc` to `~/.zshrc` before Oh My Zsh was installed (or its installation failed), and the dotfiles' `.zshrc` sources `$ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh` unconditionally, so every new shell printed the error and started without the framework, the theme or the plugins.

Expected: Oh My Zsh is installed whenever the zsh integration is set up, and the rc file degrades gracefully when it is absent.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/202#issuecomment-5711689643
Code vs intent: the failure mode is only half closed. `install` now installs Oh My Zsh, but `config/zsh/.zshrc` line 25 still does `source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh` unguarded, so if the framework installer fails or `~/.oh-my-zsh` is removed, every shell prints the same error as in the report. Also note the Oh My Zsh installer rewrites `~/.zshrc` with its template; the ordering (append source line, then install OMZ) relies on the template preserving it.
